info.description: Local network inventory and monitoring application
info.title: LANnventory API

get.description:
Retrieve recent host activity events ordered by Date descending, then ID descending.
First page requests omit beforeDate and beforeId. To request the next page, send the Date and ID from the final event returned by the previous page as beforeDate and beforeId.
Cursor pagination requires both beforeDate and beforeId. beforeDate must use YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss, beforeId must be greater than 0, and nonzero legacy offset cannot be combined with a cursor. offset=0 with a cursor is accepted.
Legacy offset pagination remains supported when beforeDate and beforeId are omitted.

parameters.description: Event limit from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Legacy event offset, 0 or greater. Used only when beforeDate and beforeId are omitted.
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description: Cursor event date in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format. Requires beforeId.
parameters.name: beforeDate

parameters.description: Cursor event ID, greater than 0. Requires beforeDate.
parameters.name: beforeId

get.description: Retrieve devices represented in current hosts and retained activity events
Retrieve faceted retained activity event counts
Retrieve all current hosts from the database, enriched with inventory metadata and lifecycle fields.
Returns the current configuration used by the app

get.description: Update a host's name and optionally toggle its "known" status

parameters.description: Pass 'toggle' to flip the known/unknown status
parameters.name: known

get.description: Export a versioned logical backup containing current hosts, host history, activity events, host metadata, host lifecycle and managed device profiles. Configuration secrets are not included.
Export the current device inventory, metadata and lifecycle as CSV. This is not a full backup and does not include history or events.
Returns OK without triggering scans or mutations

Retrieve the complete history of all hosts. Not recommended, the output can be a lot
Inventory metadata fields are not included on history rows.

Retrieve the latest history entries for a specific host by MAC address
Inventory metadata fields are not included on history rows.

parameters.description: Number of history entries to return
parameters.name: num

get.description:
Retrieve history for a specific host on a given date
Inventory metadata fields are not included on history rows.
The date format is flexible and can be:
- Year only: `2025`
- Year + month: `2025-09`
- Full date: `2025-09-06`
- Full timestamp: `2025-09-06 00:58:26`

parameters.description: Date filter (supports YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss)
parameters.name: date

get.description:
Add host by MAC, with optional Name, IP, Hardware
Returns `models.Host` with this MAC form DB, either just added or existing
Remove a host from the database by its unique ID
Retrieve detailed information about a current host by its unique ID, enriched with inventory metadata and lifecycle fields.

patch.description: Atomically update editable host fields and manually managed inventory metadata. Actual known, device type, and metadata changes are recorded as Device change events. Name changes do not create events.

get.description: Retrieve recent host activity events for a host ID
get.summary: Get recent activity for one host

parameters.description: Event limit from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Return retained addresses, reverse address-to-MAC history, discovery evidence, and discovery sources for a host without changing user-managed inventory fields.
Return read-only, explainable suggestions for MAC identities that may represent the same physical device. This endpoint never merges or mutates identities.
Return user-confirmed or user-rejected MAC relationships for a host. Decisions do not merge host observations, events, presence, or lifecycle history.

put.description: Confirm or reject that another observed MAC identity belongs to the same physical device. This records user intent only and never merges historical observations. Contradictory confirmed/rejected relationship graphs are rejected.

delete.description: Remove the user's explicit confirm/reject decision for a MAC pair without modifying either identity or its historical observations.

get.description: Return the transitive group of MAC identities explicitly confirmed by the user as the same physical device. The projection is read only and does not rewrite Hosts, Events, Presence, or historical observations.

patch.description: Partially update manually managed inventory metadata. Tags are trimmed, empty tags are removed, duplicates are removed case-insensitively, and user order is preserved. Actual changes are recorded as Device change events.

post.description: Scan a TCP port using the host's current IP. Definitive results update persistent service inventory and emit lifecycle activity only on state transitions. Indeterminate transport failures are returned without changing persisted service state.
post.summary: Scan one port for a host

get.description: Return manually managed generic and typed device-profile information. Imported/discovered integration data is stored separately and never overwrites these fields.

patch.description: Partially update manually managed generic device-profile fields. Empty values clear fields; clearing all fields removes the managed base profile row.

delete.description: Remove only the manual Hypervisor capability/profile. The Host and its generic/system inventory remain unchanged.

patch.description: Mark a Host as a managed hypervisor capability and store manually maintained platform details. This does not change Device Type and does not use credentials.
patch.summary: Create or update managed hypervisor profile

patch.description: Partially update network-device-specific managed fields. Physical port count 0 means not set.
Partially update lightweight Server/NAS system inventory without changing the Host Device Type.

get.description: Return the non-secret API connection configuration for one Proxmox Host. The stored token secret is never returned.

patch.description: Update one Proxmox Host API connection. tokenSecret is write-only: omit or send blank to keep it, send a non-empty value to replace it, or clearTokenSecret=true to remove it.

post.description: Revalidate the API Snapshot and stale-preview token, then apply it through the existing atomic Proxmox import pipeline.
post.summary: Apply confirmed Proxmox API inventory preview

post.description: Perform a read-only API collection and feed the normalized Snapshot into the existing Preview/Diff pipeline. No inventory changes are applied.
post.summary: Collect and preview Proxmox API inventory

post.description: Authenticate and verify read-only node and guest inventory access. This never imports or changes LANnventory inventory.
Revalidate a previously previewed snapshot and atomically apply it only when the preview token still matches current persisted state.

parameters.description: Confirmed preview token and collector snapshot
parameters.name: body

post.description: Strictly validate a read-only collector snapshot and return a deterministic diff. This endpoint never persists the snapshot.

get.description: Return the last successfully applied Proxmox node state for one source. source defaults to script-import and may also be proxmox-api. Managed HypervisorProfile fields remain separate.
Return opt-in scheduled TCP service scan settings and runtime state for a host.

put.description: Enable or disable scheduled TCP service scanning for a host. Ports are validated, de-duplicated and sorted. Enabling or changing settings schedules the next scan immediately.

get.description: Return durable service summary records for the host MAC across retained IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.
get.summary: Get retained services for a host

patch.description: Update only a host's manually assigned device type

get.description: Return explainable workload-to-Host candidates. Exact MAC is the only automatic evidence; address and name evidence remain suggestions. This endpoint never mutates links.
get.summary: Get Proxmox workload Host match candidates

get.description: Return infrastructure workloads hosted by one configured hypervisor. Workloads remain separate from LANnventory Hosts.

post.description: Add or update a manual VM/LXC inventory object by native ID and type. This never creates a LANnventory Host.
post.summary: Add or update a manual hypervisor workload

delete.description: Delete a manually maintained workload inventory object. Imported workload retirement uses snapshot reconciliation instead.

patch.description: Update manually maintained workload fields while keeping native ID and workload type immutable.

put.description: Create or replace the logical MATCHES relation without merging workload or Host identity/history.
put.summary: Link workload to an existing Host

delete.description: Remove only the logical MATCHES relation. Workload and Host records remain unchanged.

put.description: Persist a non-destructive "Not this Host" decision for the current weak address/name evidence. Exact-MAC evidence cannot be rejected here, and changed evidence is re-evaluated automatically.
put.summary: Reject a weak workload Host candidate

delete.description: Remove only the explicit "Not this Host" decision. Workload, Host identity/history, and links remain unchanged.
delete.summary: Clear a workload Host candidate rejection

get.description: Return every retained MAC identity observed using one IP address, including first/last seen timestamps.
Return read-only reverse projections for persisted workload MATCHES relations. Optional hostId limits the response to one current LANnventory Host.
Return read-only VM/container counts from current non-retired workload inventory. Running and stopped workloads both count.
get.summary: Get current workload counts by hypervisor

get.description: Retrieve distinct owner and location values from current host metadata for lightweight autocomplete.
Trigger a test notification to verify notification settings
Check whether a given TCP port on an address is open or closed

200.description: true if open, false if closed

get.description: Manually trigger rescan
Retrieve summary statistics of hosts, optionally filtered by interface

post.description: Verifies and schedules installation of the newest release in the configured channel. The service restarts after the package update is scheduled.
Persists the Stable or Beta update channel without triggering a release check.
Persists release channel, automatic check/install preferences, and automatic check interval without triggering a release check.

get.description: Returns cached release metadata without contacting GitHub. Set refresh=true only for an explicit manual update check.

parameters.description: Deprecated compatibility flag; cached-only is the default
